name: spotlight-beam
title: Spotlight Beam
description: A large, tilted beam of light that sweeps in once when the section scrolls into view, and can lean toward the pointer.

props.name: variant
props.description: Where the light comes from: a top corner shining diagonally, or straight down from the top center.

props.name: follow
props.description: The light source leans a little toward the pointer while it moves over the section.

props.name: children / slot
props.description: Content shown on top of the beam.

a11y: The beam layer is aria-hidden and ignores pointer events.
The entrance plays once, the first time the section scrolls into view.
With reduced motion, the beam shows in place right away and does not follow the pointer.

ai.whenToUse: A cinematic backdrop for a hero, sign-in screen, or launch section that needs one strong light source.
rules: Set the background color, padding, and radius with class on the component
Use intensity=soft on light backgrounds and strong on dark ones
Use follow only on large sections where the pointer moves a lot

id.description: Berkas cahaya besar dan miring yang masuk sekali saat section masuk layar, dan bisa condong ke arah pointer.

props.variant: Asal cahaya: sudut atas yang menyorot miring, atau lurus ke bawah dari tengah atas.
props.follow: Sumber cahaya sedikit condong ke arah pointer saat bergerak di atas section.
props.children / slot: Konten yang tampil di atas berkas cahaya.

a11y: Lapisan cahaya memakai aria-hidden dan mengabaikan pointer.
Animasi masuk diputar sekali, saat section pertama kali masuk layar.
Dengan reduced motion, berkas cahaya langsung tampil di tempatnya dan tidak mengikuti pointer.

ai.whenToUse: Latar sinematik untuk hero, layar masuk, atau section peluncuran yang butuh satu sumber cahaya kuat.
rules: Atur warna latar, padding, dan radius lewat class pada komponen
Pakai intensity=soft di latar terang dan strong di latar gelap
Pakai follow hanya di section besar tempat pointer banyak bergerak
